scripts.build: npm i && npm run convert-yaml-grammar && npm run compile-ts
scripts.compile-grammar: mkdir -p grammar/out && sleep 0.1 && nearleyc grammar/angelscript.ne -o grammar/out/angelscript.js
scripts.convert-yaml-grammar: mkdir -p grammar/out && sleep 0.1 && js-yaml grammar/angelscript.tmLanguage.yaml > grammar/out/angelscript.tmLanguage.json
scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm i && cd ../server && npm i && cd ..
